summary: The initial roster SSE snapshot now uses the same five-second context deadline as event-triggered refresh snapshots. A stalled initial SFU/database load can return service unavailable instead of leaving prejoin without a response indefinitely.

checks.name: Test-first initial snapshot deadline regression
checks.observation: The new focused test failed before the fix because the initial Lister.List received no context deadline. After the fix, the lister receives a deadline no more than five seconds away.

limits: No production deployment, LiveKit outage reproduction, client retry observation, two-account ACL test, device test, or ADB validation was performed.
